hero.title: Know before you invest.
hero.lead: Evaluate whether your business idea makes sense for your location, market, finances and available government support.
hero.proofText: Clear evidence, visible assumptions and useful next steps.

home.heroTitle: Make a more informed business decision.
home.heroDescription: Tell us where you want to operate, how much capital you have, and what business you are considering. UdyamSaarthi-AI combines available local evidence with financial planning to prepare a preliminary feasibility report.
home.infoDescription: The report is designed to show both opportunity and uncertainty.

assessment.title: Let's assess your business.
assessment.description: A short guided assessment. Your inputs are used to build a location-specific feasibility report.
assessment.decision: Not just a score. A decision.
assessment.decisionText: The report brings the important pieces together so you can see what looks attractive, where caution is needed and what evidence is still unavailable.

how.title: Three steps from idea to decision.
how.description: You provide the context. UdyamSaarthi does the analysis.
how.oneText: Share your location, business category and available capital.
how.twoText: Local evidence, competition, pricing and financial information are evaluated.
how.threeText: Receive a viability score, risks, opportunities and next steps.

form.heading: Tell us about your business idea
form.description: Enter the best information you have. More precise location and capital information makes the assessment more useful.
form.locationDescription: Tell us where you want to operate so the local business environment can be assessed.
form.blockHint: Optional — leave blank if you're not sure.
form.locationEvidenceNote: Your location helps connect the assessment with available local and regional evidence.
form.businessTitle: What business do you want to start?
form.businessDescription: Choose the business you are considering.
form.businessEvidenceNote: Business-specific analysis will use the selected category and available location evidence.
form.capitalTitle: How much capital do you have?
form.capitalDescription: Enter the amount you can invest in the business from your own funds.
form.capitalHelp: Enter the amount of your own capital available for the business.
form.capitalHint: Enter a positive whole number in Indian rupees.
form.capitalExampleText: If you can invest ₹50,000 yourself, enter 50000.
form.capitalEvidenceNote: Your own capital helps determine the financial structure and viability of the business.

errors.capitalPositive: Capital must be a positive number.
errors.capitalInteger: Capital must be a whole number.

businessCategories.KiranaDescription: Local grocery and everyday household products.
businessCategories.TailoringDescription: Clothing stitching, alterations and tailoring services.
businessCategories.Food ProcessingDescription: Processing, packaging and value addition of food products.
businessCategories.Repair ShopDescription: Repair and maintenance services for common products or equipment.

report.title: Business Feasibility Report
report.description: Your business idea has been evaluated using available location, market, competition and financial evidence.
report.decisionTitle: What should you know before investing?
report.competitionHelper: Context based on identifiable competitor data
report.financialNote: Financial and planning parameters are for planning only. Verify them against current official guidelines before borrowing.
report.provisionalFinancialWarning: Current financial scheme parameters are provisional and must be verified against the applicable official government guideline.
report.competitionNote: Competition reflects businesses identified in available data. Informal or unlisted businesses may not be included.
report.improve: Ways to improve the business idea
report.improvementSuggestions: Ways to strengthen your chosen business
report.estimatedPriceDescription: Local verified pricing was not available, so the displayed range is a development estimate and should be validated locally.
report.validate: Use the report for validation, not as a guarantee.
report.validateText: Recheck the most important assumptions before committing capital.
report.saturationDescription: Competition is a signal to investigate differentiation, not proof that the business cannot work.
report.generic: Something went wrong while generating the report. Please try again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong while generating the report. Please try again.

map.noLocationsTitle: No identifiable competitor locations are available.
map.noLocationsText: Available data does not currently contain businesses in this category that can be displayed on the map.
map.noLocationsNote: This does not mean no competitors exist. Informal, unregistered or unlisted businesses may not be included.
map.noCoordinatesTitle: Competitors were identified, but their locations are not available for mapping.
